assistantHelp: Reviews use the bound Assistant's account and access rules. After saving repository rules, enable GitHub events in the Assistant's Automation settings.
workflowHelp: Workflow diagnosis always uses the bound Assistant and can run alongside the PR pipeline. Enable the Assistant's GitHub event trigger; new diagnoses follow Assistant access and are not published to GitHub.
workflows: Workflow names (one per line; empty means all)
actionsHelp: Workflow diagnosis requires Actions: Read and Workflow run events. Timeout diagnosis also requires Checks: Read to distinguish job timeouts from ordinary cancellations.
empty: No workflow diagnoses yet. Configure repository rules and enable the GitHub event trigger.
privateResult: Save a private review draft. Publishing to GitHub is a separate action.
github_trigger_paused: Enable GitHub events in the Assistant's Automation settings.
actions_permission_required: Grant Actions: Read to the GitHub App, then save these rules again.
checks_permission_required: Grant Checks: Read to the GitHub App installation for timeout diagnosis, then save these rules again.
workflow_cancelled: Cancelled without confirmed timeout evidence; no diagnosis was started.
workflow_timeout_evidence_unavailable: Complete GitHub timeout evidence is unavailable. Retrying without starting diagnosis.
workflow_evidence_mismatch: GitHub job evidence does not match this run attempt.
code_review_capability_unavailable: Enable Code review on this Assistant and check your access.
workflow_requires_assistant: Select Current Assistant for workflow diagnosis.
unknownError: Operation failed. Check the connection and try again.
